author: The Current
description:
Gary Louris reflects on 40 years of The Jayhawks
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The Jayhawks released their debut, self-titled album in 1986 — 40 years ago, having formed a couple years prior to that. In an interview with Diane on The Local Show, the Jayhawks’ Gary Louris reflects on 40 years as a band: What it means to the group and also what it means to him personally. “I think it took me a while to appreciate what we had,” Louris says.

Watch more in the video above, and find a studio session of the Jayhawks playing songs from their 2026 album, “Sanctuary Park,” here: https://youtu.be/fUAOqqE2v-A

Nate and Sam from The Format talk about new song, "The Bar Is Set So Low" 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Nate Reuss and Sam Means of The Format visited The Current for a Gig List interview hosted by Nilufer Arsala. During their conversation, Nate and Sam talked about The Format’s new single, “The Bar Is Set So Low,” all proceeds from which will go to immigrant-rights organizations.
